text:
ara-ps: Heads up team — onboarding CrestBank pilot. They tunnel a single HTTP/2 connection and want to multiplex dozens of logical streams. Main asks: Python mux snippet, simple curl fallback, telemetry labels for NewRelic, ephemeral token rotation guidance, and SOC2 questionnaire turn-around.

jay-sales: Demo Fri 11am ET. They start on Hosted; may request Dedicated if jitter/latency is bad.

susan-runtime: Python example (minimal):
```py
from redwood import Client
c=Client(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'), enable_mux=True)
stream=c.stream(model='gpt-4o-infer', stream_id='crest-1', trace=True)
for chunk in stream: print(chunk)
```
Fallback (curl): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'

susan-runtime: Telemetry: add tags per logical stream: service=crestbank, env=pilot, stream_id, demo_id. Include x-trace-id to correlate with NewRelic.

leo-devex: For function/tool calling show them a tiny JSON schema they can validate locally. Recommend 5 sample prompts for Optimize validation. I'll draft a 1-page runbook + two snippets.

compliance-bot: SOC2: please have procurement send vendor questionnaire PDF to security@redwood.ai. Blockers: need dataflow diagram, retention policy, PII flag, and KMS info if Dedicated. Typical turnaround 2-4 business days after docs.

ara-ps: Pricing ask — they may hit spikes ~2k QPS for short bursts (3-7 min). Any quick guidance?

jay-sales: Ballpark: for that pattern recommend Hosted with negotiated burst credits or a small Dedicated slice. Dedicated slice for peak handling typically $6k-12k/mo depending on GPU. For demo: offer a 5-min 1k QPS sim to prove perf.

leo-devex: I'll aim to post the runbook and snippets by EOD today. Quick sync tomorrow 9am PT?

susan-runtime: Works for me.

ara-ps: Thanks all — sending initial payloads and QPS profile to the thread now. :rocket:
